note: The only vendor instances a qualification runner may write to. A runner establishes the instance it is talking to by live observation (GET /account-info/v3/details; GET /services/oauth2/userinfo + the Organization record) and refuses to write unless the observed identity is listed here. This is an allowlist, not a hardcoded authority: the observation decides which instance was touched, the list decides whether touching it was permitted.

excluded.reason: STANDARD account holding real customer records; written once on 2026-09-02 (see qualification/evidence/HUBSPOT_SCOPE_BLOCKER.md); out of scope for every qualification from MC-3 on, and its evidence is historical only. A blocklist needs the identifier and nothing else: the census of what that account holds was here too, and it is somebody's data described in a file this repository publishes.
